approval.scope: OWASP ZAP baseline on http://localhost:8000 (docker compose, test data only)

tools.name: zap-baseline
tools.command: docker run --network host ghcr.io/zaproxy/zaproxy:stable zap-baseline.py -t http://localhost:8000

tools.name: mobsf
tools.note: MobSF not installed; run: docker run -p 8001:8000 opensecurity/mobile-security-framework-mobsf and upload app-release.apk

findings.title: Account enumeration through sign-in error message
findings.severity_rationale: Enables targeted credential stuffing against a must-have mitigation (TM-01); same issue as DEF-001
findings.remediation: Return the same message and status for unknown email and wrong password; add a test

findings.title: Insufficiently Protected Credentials in Requests
findings.remediation: Upgrade requests to 2.20.0 or later (pinned by a legacy constraint in api/constraints.txt)

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy header on the web dashboard
findings.severity_rationale: ZAP passive alert (medium); no injection point found, defense in depth
findings.remediation: Serve a restrictive CSP from the reverse proxy; see standards/security.md

not_run: MobSF static analysis of the Android APK (tool not installed)
